shado-pan.title: Shado-Pan notes
items: Line up {Zenith} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows, and detonate the {Flurry Strikes} from {Stand Ready} with {Fists of Fury}
{Zenith} has 2 charges, so don't rush it; you can save it for the next pull or burst window

conduit-of-the-celestials.title: Conduit of the Celestials notes
items: After {Invoke Xuen}, channel {Celestial Conduit} once the {Heart of the Jade Serpent} from {Whirling Dragon Punch} has ended
Line up {Zenith} with a {Heart of the Jade Serpent} window and use it on big pulls and boss burst

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone). If Touch of Karma is down when Carrion Burst Nature DoTs stack during Ssscavenging, use Fortifying Brew (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. Use Zenith (2 charges, 1 min 30 sec) on each shield and break it with Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick. The Conduit of the Celestials build also lines Invoke Xuen (2 min) up with a shield (Topicx)
[해제] Clear the Regurgitate disease with Detox. It removes the 50% movement speed and damage done reduction from the hit player
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) in the Toxic Atrophy triple-kick rotation, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits it into five Writhes, use Zenith with Bloodlust and hit them together with Whirling Dragon Punch and Fists of Fury. The Conduit of the Celestials build adds Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit (Topicx)

[해제] Clear Spiteful Venom poison stacks from the Writhes with Detox. Hold a Writhe closing in on its fixate target with Leg Sweep, and with the Shado-Pan build the Stillstep Coil slow helps open distance (Wowhead)
Zul'jan: [위치] If your beam spot is far, use Roll or Flying Serpent Kick to arrive before the Ritual of the Fang channel
[광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma (10 sec) for the 8 sec channel while you body-block a beam (38793 Nature every 1 sec). This channel is also when the party uses its defensives (Topicx)
[참고] After deliberately taking Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom, top yourself off with Expel Harm if you are low (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation, so kick it whenever Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) is ready

[광역 피해] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec, so go in with Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) up, and Roll out of the patch when the beam ends
[회피] Roll out of Lightsower Dash and Fan Of Thorns
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Use Tiger's Lust on allies rooted by Bloodthorn Roots to free them
[회피] If you're the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Roll and Flying Serpent Kick
[광역 피해] Split Touch of Karma and Fortifying Brew between Thorncaller Roar and the Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) in the interrupt rotation for Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature), which repeats on the tank during Moonkin Form
[참고] If you get a Pulverizing Strikes mark with Grievous Thrash bleed still on you, top yourself off with Expel Harm and pop Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) before the cones arrive
[광역 피해] Save Fortifying Brew for Spirits of the Vale after 40%, and use Zenith to end that phase quickly
Ziekket: [차단] Use Spear Hand Strike on the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before the rebirth, and delay casts of grouped Lashers with Leg Sweep
[광역 피해] Against constant Oozing Xylem damage, use Expel Harm on cooldown to top yourself up

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Detox the Toxic Spores poison stacked from stepping on Spoiled Supplies mushrooms. Start with the party members who stepped on the most (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Touch of Karma for Ravenous Bellow's party-wide damage, and move between mushroom soaks with Roll
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) in the rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud (4 sec cast, 96982 Frost to everyone). As melee, take the add next to the boss

[우선 처치] Melee take the add next to the boss, so time Zenith and Whirling Dragon Punch so it dies at the same time as the add the ranged are on. If your add drops too fast, swap damage to the boss (Topicx)
[위치] Roll into the Snowdrift before Frozen Tempest. Do not Roll or Flying Serpent Kick toward the snow and ice at the room's edge (Topicx)
Nalorakk: [위치] When targeted by Echoing Maul, use Flying Serpent Kick or Roll to reach this set's corner within 4 sec. Use a different corner for each set so the Echoes are spread evenly around the room (Topicx)
[광역 피해] When an Echo lands it deals 193965 Nature within 8 yd of the target, so pop Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) when targeted by Echoing Maul. If it is on cooldown, use Fortifying Brew (Topicx)

[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, top yourself off with Expel Harm while body-blocking Echoes and taking Echoing Fury (67888 Nature), and if you saved the third Bloodlust for this boss, line up Zenith with the pull (Topicx)

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] In the first 20 sec Destabilized window, stack one Zenith charge and Invoke Xuen (Conduit of the Celestials build) to take Kystia to about 40%, then finish her in the second window with the remaining Zenith charge. Pop Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) for the party DoT in this window (Topicx)
[차단] Kick one Mirror Images clone's Felstorm with Spear Hand Strike, and stop the gathered clones together with Leg Sweep
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] Line up Zenith and Invoke Xuen (Conduit of the Celestials build) with the second Bloodlust that starts with the worker pack after the RP, and kill Keen Taskmaster first. Remove the Back to Work! Enrage with Paralysis (Pressure Points, Wowhead) (Topicx)
[해제] Clear the Heartstop Poison (30% max health reduction) that Envenom puts on the tank with Detox right away (Wowhead)
[회피] Roll behind the nearest barrel before Murder in a Row. Several players can hide behind one barrel, and a shot barrel explodes 5 sec later, so Roll away before then (Topicx)
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] Use Zenith when Demonic Rage makes the boss take 30% more damage. The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage, so hold Invoke Xuen (Conduit of the Celestials build) until then (Topicx)
[우선 처치] Break the Axe Toss axe quickly with Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick, and Roll out of Burning Steps patches
[광역 피해] If Infernal Crush comes while an axe is still up, pop Touch of Karma
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the Chaos Bolt interrupt rotation
[광역 피해] Use damage cooldowns when Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imps appear, not on the boss. Use Zenith and hit the adds together with Whirling Dragon Punch (Topicx)
[제어] Delay the gathered Wild Imps' Felfire Burst from Fingers of Gul'dan with Leg Sweep and kill them with Spinning Crane Kick

Taz'Rah: [회피] Save Roll charges to dodge the Void Fissure orbs during Dark Bloom
[광역 피해] Dark Bloom (174568 Shadow to everyone) is the biggest party damage in this fight, so line up Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec), and if it is on cooldown, use Fortifying Brew (Topicx)
[위치] While Nether Dash lines are up, do not make big moves with Roll or Flying Serpent Kick. The line follows you and can cross a party member's line (Topicx)
Atroxus: [해제] Detox the Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool
[광역 피해] When Toxic Creeper spawns after Monstrous Roar, pop Zenith and kill the Creeper fast
Charonus: [위치] Melee use the two Singularities in front of the boss. If Gravitic Orbs fixates you and Condensed Mass slows stack up, clear them with Tiger's Lust and run to the nearest Singularity (Topicx)
[광역 피해] If Condensed Mass Shadow DoT stacks build while you drag the orb past the Singularities, pop Touch of Karma (Topicx)
[회피] If you are the Void Cascade target, move away from the party and keep running in one direction, left or right, using Roll and Flying Serpent Kick to open distance (Topicx)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Lock down Animated Gold packs awakened by Lucre's Call with Leg Sweep, and drop Ring of Peace around the boss to block their approach
[광역 피해] Use Touch of Karma for Serpentine Gust AoE damage
Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on Mchimba (Topicx), so pop Zenith at the start, and the Conduit of the Celestials build lines up Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit with Bloodlust
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the kick rotation for Wretched Discharge from Half-Finished Mummy and Finished Mummy, and remove the disease with Detox
[위치] Use Roll to get to the shaking crypt quickly during Entomb
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] You drag in the trash in front and kill it with Kula, and Kula must die before the fourth Whirling Axes (Topicx), so line up Zenith and, in the Conduit of the Celestials build, Invoke Xuen on Kula at the start
[차단] Use Spear Hand Strike on Zanazal's Poison Nova, and remove the poison with Detox if the kick is missed
[위치] Roll straight into the Barrel Through soak spot. Barrel Through keeps coming even after Aka'ali dies
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar and Reban must die before 80% (Topicx), so line up Zenith and, in the Conduit of the Celestials build, Invoke Xuen on Reban at the start
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar
[광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma for Gilded Destruction (155172 Fire to everyone plus a 15 sec Fire DoT), and if it is on cooldown, use Fortifying Brew and top up with Expel Harm

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx). Only use Spear Hand Strike on it if the tank misses
[제어] Hold the intermission Infused Whelp pack with Leg Sweep, and pop Zenith to break Ice Bulwark fast
[광역 피해] The intermission, where whelps overlap with Frost Overload, is the biggest party damage, so line up Touch of Karma there (Topicx)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the kick rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] The Firestorm must die before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx), so spend a Zenith charge when it spawns, and Roll out of Burnout (484912 Fire within 20 yd) right before it dies
[회피] Roll well clear of the Molten Boulder path
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of the Interrupting Cloudburst cast, do not start a new Fists of Fury or Spinning Crane Kick channel
[광역 피해] If you get Inferno Spit, move out of the party and pop Touch of Karma as the 6 sec DoT ends and explodes (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Save one Zenith for the start of phase 2, and after they merge, focus the lower-health boss (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [회피] After Gale Force pushes you, Roll straight back to your Thunder and Lightning soak spot
[광역 피해] Use Touch of Karma during the Aspix Frenzy phase after Adderis dies
Merektha: [제어] When the two A Knot of Snakes targets stack, stun the knots together with Leg Sweep to free them, and if there is only one, free it with Paralysis. Kill the released snakes with Spinning Crane Kick
[해제] Remove the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit poison with Detox (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma for Serpentstorm (knockback, 116379 Nature to everyone plus an 8 sec DoT). This is where party defensives go (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] When it's your turn to block the Lightning Spire beam, absorb the Galvanized damage with Touch of Karma
[회피] Roll out of the Induction Field right after Induction
Avatar of Sethraliss: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the kick rotation for Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
[위치] When the Corrupted Guardian dies, DPS take the Corrupted Lifeforce soaks, so Roll in right away to soak one, and hold through the Corruption Shadow DoT with Touch of Karma or Expel Harm (Topicx)
[제어] Keep the phase 2 Faithless Tormentors off the healer with Leg Sweep and Ring of Peace, and Roll over the green orbs they leave quickly (Topicx)

강력한 진각을 방출해 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 700%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

[광역 피해] Once everything is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, use one Zenith charge (2 charges) to open with Zenith Stomp AoE, and the Conduit of the Celestials build adds Invoke Xuen (2 min) and Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec). Pop Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove or starts Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel), hold it with Leg Sweep (1 min, 10 yd radius, 3 sec stun). With the Shado-Pan build, Stillstep Coil adds a 5 sec slow after the stun ends (Wowhead).
2: [우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher wraps itself in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108), target it and break the shield with Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury. It is immune to crowd control while shielded, so Leg Sweep and Paralysis will not work.
[차단] One Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) cannot cover both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, so take one and hand the other to another interrupter.

[광역 피해] If Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec) from pull 1 is not back yet, top yourself off with Expel Harm (15 sec) after Spouting Floret. Strength of Spirit raises its healing up to double based on your missing health.
3: [제어] With 12 Lashers in this pull, a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove is dangerous. Stun it with Leg Sweep if it is back, and if it is already more than 10 yd away, stop it with Paralysis (45 sec, 20 yd) and kill it right away. Paralysis can break on damage.
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the Light Bolt Volley interrupt rotation.
5: [광역 피해] This is the first big pull after the boss, so use Zenith on the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first, and the Conduit of the Celestials build adds Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit. Pop Touch of Karma for Spouting Floret.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) with Spear Hand Strike.
[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal cone with knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) can be stopped with a stun (Topicx), so stop it with Leg Sweep (1 min).
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Spear Hand Strike. If Spear Hand Strike is free, also kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot.
[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stun both with a single Leg Sweep while they are within 10 yd of you.
[회피] Roll (3 charges) out of the two Luminous Thornmaws' Solar Breath (387930 Holy frontal cone).
8: [광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and if it is on cooldown, top yourself off with Expel Harm.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Leg Sweep, and when you have room, kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot with Spear Hand Strike.
10: [해제] Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew is a poison that deals 58189 Nature to the whole party every 1.5 sec for 9 sec, and Detox has an 8 sec cooldown, so you can only clear one player at a time. Clear the healer and low-health players first.

[광역 피해] The adds are cleared first, so use Fists of Fury and Whirling Dragon Punch on the Lasher pack and save Zenith (plus Invoke Xuen in the Conduit of the Celestials build) for the Potatoad Matriarch you engage afterward.
11: [제어] One Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so if the three are stacked and casting together, stun them all with Leg Sweep to stop the casts.
[광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and Roll out of Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath cone.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so spend all Zenith charges, and the Conduit of the Celestials build uses Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit together. If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap, add Fortifying Brew (5 min 30 sec) to Touch of Karma.
[우선 처치] Among the six Lightgorged Lashers, target the ones wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield and break it with Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury. Shielded ones are immune to crowd control.
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike in the interrupt rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, and hold one that flees with Call The Grove using Leg Sweep.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec, melee).

Three seconds without melee swings drops the 2 sec stacks. With the Shado-Pan build, Stillstep Coil adds a 5 sec slow after the stun, which helps the tank gain distance (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] If you are hit by Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec), pop Touch of Karma (1 min 30 sec, absorbs up to 50% of max health for 10 sec).
2: [우선 처치] Focus Ritual Chieftain with Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury so it dies before Blood Sacrifice comes several times.

4: [우선 처치] Use one Zenith charge (2 charges, 1 min 30 sec) on Ritual Chieftain to kill it first, and take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Spear Hand Strike.

[광역 피해] If the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs overlap with Blood Sacrifice, add Fortifying Brew to Touch of Karma.
[회피] Roll (3 charges with Celerity) to the side of the Harrower to dodge the Toxic Breath frontal (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec).
7: [제어] Stop High Evolutionist's Evolve (6 sec channel) with a 3 sec Leg Sweep stun to prevent the shield and crowd control immunity. The same stun also stops the three Bloodletters' melee swings.

8: [제어] Stun all four Bloodletters with one Leg Sweep to slow the blood pools. If Leg Sweep (1 min) from pull 7 is not back, hold one with Paralysis (45 sec, 20 yd). Paralysis can break on damage.

11: [제어] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Spear Hand Strike, and if several channel Evolve together, stun them all at once with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius).

15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Spear Hand Strike.

16: [우선 처치] Stack Zenith charges and, in the Conduit of the Celestials build, Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Spear Hand Strike.

5: [우선 처치] Use Zenith on Massive Felwyrm and focus it with Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to kill it first. While it lives, Over-infused deals 38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec.

8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) with Spear Hand Strike. If it finishes, the Flayer takes 60% less damage and is immune to crowd control for 1 min.

[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel (channel) with the Spear Hand Strike left over after Fel Rage.
9: [광역 피해] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, pop Touch of Karma to absorb the damage, and if it is on cooldown, use Fortifying Brew (5 min 30 sec with Expeditious Fortification).
[우선 처치] When Corrupted Warlock puts up the Dark Pact shield (30% of max health) at 50%, break it with Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury. Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Spear Hand Strike.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Spear Hand Strike.

11: [광역 피해] For Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire to the whole party every 0.4 sec), use Touch of Karma on the first and Fortifying Brew on the second.

13: [광역 피해] Pop Touch of Karma for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone), and Roll away from the Defiled Detonations that land around it (193965 Shadow within 5 yd).

15: [광역 피해] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, pop Touch of Karma, and keep Fortifying Brew for when Shivan Punisher starts Demonic Frenzy below 50%.

2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec). If both line up, kick Healing Breeze first.

4: [광역 피해] If the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every 1 sec for 10 sec, stacks) build up, pop Touch of Karma, and if it is on cooldown, top yourself off with Expel Harm (15 sec).

5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Spear Hand Strike, and remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Paralysis (Pressure Points).

9: [우선 처치] Finish the Devour target with Touch of Death, and use Whirling Dragon Punch and Spinning Crane Kick on the ten Scavenging Siphoids.
